Name: More Level Up Notifications
Author: binarynova
Description:
[u]Compatibility[/u]
[list]
[*]Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6!
[/list]
[u]Installation[/u]
[list]
[*]Install automatically using Vortex, or extract the contents of the .zip file into the Mods folder in your Stardew Valley installation folder.
[/list]
[u]About[/u]
[list]
[*]Normally in 1.6 the game displays the level up notification "You've got some new ideas to sleep on..." only once per day, even if you level multiple skills, or a single skill more than once. This mod changes that behavior and displays the level up notification for each and every level up in a single day.
[*]It does this by making a whole new notification and displaying it only on subsequent level ups during a day, and resets that counter every morning.
[/list]
[u]Source[/u]
[list]
[*]The source code for this and my other Stardew Valley mods can be found on GitHub [url=https://github.com/Binarynova/MyStardewMods]here[/url]﻿.
[/list]
[u]Donations[/u]
[list]
[*]NexusMods directs 100% of Donation Points earned by this mod to the [url=http://www.wcs.org]Wildlife Conservation Society[/url]﻿.
[/list]

Downloads.Description: Displays the level up notification every time you level up in a single day!

Manifest.Name: Level Up Notifications
Manifest.Description: This mod notifies you for multiple levels gained during the same day.
